name: The blood of the Banshee Queen
summary: To Sylvanas, the vial returns a remnant of the blood the Lich King once drew from her. She pauses over what has been returned. Arthas has paid for the harm he imposed, yet Sylvanas wonders what can become of those freed from his grasp while still bound to mortal life. She offers a music box and asks for solitude; victory has opened no easy road beyond her grief.
